h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruchirappalli

items.pText: When the bell rings for the break in a large Tiruchirappalli school, hundreds of children can reach the playground within a few minutes. The equipment has to give them all something to do without a crowd on one slide. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Trichy at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,140 km away.

Trichy is one of Tamil Nadu's main education centres, with the Rockfort at its heart and Srirangam across the Kaveri. Summers are long and hot, and most of the rain comes from October to December. We truck the equipment to Trichy and install it with our own crew or a dealer in south India. Tell us how many children use the ground at one time, and we will plan the equipment around that number on a layout drawing.

items.q: How many children can a school playground take at once?
items.a: It depends on the pieces. Each station has its own capacity, so tell us how many children come out at each break and we will suggest a mix that spreads them across the ground.

items.q: Is one big structure better than several small ones?
items.a: For large schools, several stations usually work better. Children spread out, queues are shorter and one repair does not close the whole playground.
Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East, about 1,140 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.
